seo.metaTitle: Private invoice generator — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Generate itemized freelance or SMB invoices from `templates/invoice-us.json` with automatic line-item totals and tax calculation—zero cloud accounting accounts required. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /templates/invoice-us.json with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Private invoice generator processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /templates/invoice-us.json (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Private invoice generator upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Private invoice generator executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /templates/invoice-us.json. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Private invoice generator?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/invoice_generator.json or open /tools/invoice-generator?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
